newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers quoted lower, fuel oil swaps off.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers quoted lower, fuel oil swaps off.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were quoted lower Tuesday, despite anticipated demand from China. Some traders were sidelined waiting for fresh market direction.
"The market has been waiting for China to re-enter, but so far there hasn't been anything from China," said one trader, noting little interest in bids.

Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $103-$105 per tonne and 180-cst was at $110-$112. MDO and gas oil were quoted at $190-$195 and $208-215 respectively. Fuel oil swaps were $1.50 per tonne weaker amid expectations two fuel oil cargoes would arrive in Singapore in coming weeks. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870 3571)
